## Checklist

- [ ] Behavior changes have a test; refactors don't change behavior
- [ ] Balance changes: sim diff pasted below (`npm run sim`)
- [ ] UI changes: checked at 360px (no horizontal overflow), keyboard reachable
- [ ] Docs updated if a system, API or content workflow changed
